tasks.label: kill-backend-port
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5178 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Killed PID ' + $_.OwningProcess) } catch {} }; Write-Host 'done'

tasks.label: kill-vite-port
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5273 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Killed PID ' + $_.OwningProcess) } catch { Write-Host ('Cannot kill PID ' + $_.OwningProcess + ' - try elevated terminal') } }; Write-Host 'done'
